name.ja: メカコレクション 地球連邦アンドロメダ級三番艦アポロノーム
name.en: Mecha Collection Earth Federation Andromeda Class Third Ship Apollo Nome

description.ja: メカコレクションに『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202』に登場の「地球連邦アンドロメダ級三番艦アポロノーム」が登場！
description.en: "Earth Federation Andromeda class third ship Apollo Nome " from " Space Battleship Yamato 2202" is now available in the mecha collection!

description.ja: • 手のひらサイズながら、地球連邦アンドロメダ級三番艦アポロノームのディテールを精密に再現！
description.en: • Although it is palm-sized, the details of the Earth Federation Andromeda class third ship Apollo Nome are precisely reproduced!

description.ja: • 空母型の特徴的な発着区画は新規造形！
description.en: • The characteristic take-off and landing section of the aircraft carrier type is a new model!

description.ja: • 発売中のメカコレクション 地球連邦アンドロメダ級 一番艦 アンドロメダと同スケール。並べて劇中再現が可能！
description.en: • Mecha collection being released Earth Federation Andromeda class Same scale as the first ship Andromeda. You can line them up and recreate them from the movie!

description.ja: • 五番艦アンタレスのマーキングシールも付属！
description.en: • Marking Seal of the fifth ship Antares is also included!

accessories.ja: 専用ディスプレイベース×1

contents.ja: 取扱説明書（箱裏側に記載）
contents.en: Instruction manual (written on the back of the box)
